en: Black-and-white landscape view of a valley town surrounded by forested hills and distant mountains. In the foreground there is an outdoor swimming pool complex with curved pools and small buildings around it. Scattered houses and fields extend up the slopes, and wooded ridges rise in the background. White German text is printed along the bottom border describing the scene.
